datasets.name: Landslide inventory map of Eastern Iburi
datasets.verbatim: A landslide inventory map in this region is generated by the Geographical Survey Institute (GSI) of Japan.

datasets.name: Sentinel 2A images
datasets.verbatim: In this study, Sentinel 2A images were acquired for dates before and after the landslide event.

datasets.name: 12-meter ALOS Digital Elevation Model
datasets.verbatim: we used 12-meter ALOS Digital Elevation Model to generate a slope layer used with satellite images.

methods.name: Improved Sudden Landslide Identification Product (ISLIP)
methods.summary: ISLIP is an enhanced version of the SLIP method that uses Sentinel-2 imagery and ALOS DEM. It standardizes the Red Change index, calculates mNMDI, and fuzzifies the slope layer, combining these inputs using an 'AND' fuzzy overlay operator followed by natural breaks clustering to identify landslide probability.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom ISLIP method code is not available.
